The mastermind behind New York's hottest club plucks a young man from those clamoring to get inside and hires him as a barback. With an all-star cast and a hit dance soundtrack, it's about to become the most legendary party on the planet.
A man with short-term memory loss attempts to track down his wife's murderer.

Return to rockin' Rydell High for a whole new term! It's 1961, two years after the original "Grease" gang graduated, and there's a new crop of seniors – and new members of the coolest cliques on campus.

The public Crawford was strong-willed, glamorous and admirable, but Mommie Dearest reveals the private Crawford, the woman desperate to be a mother, adopting her children when she was single and trying to survive in the devastating movie industry.

Three aliens (Jim Carrey, Damon Wayans, and Jeff Goldblum) crash-land in Los Angeles' San Fernando Valley. A manicurist (Geena Davis) and her boss (the wacky Julie Brown) befriend the threesome, give them makeovers and show them the town.

Crime drama based on the novel by Lawrence Block. An ex-Sheriff embarks on an unrelenting mission to avenge the death of a young prostitute at the hands of a ruthless pimp. How far will he go to see justice served?

When wise-cracking vamp Elvira learns that her wealthy Aunt Morgana has just died, she rushes off for the reading of the will. She can't help but stir things up when she makes her appearance in the old-fashioned, conservative town.
